'''Milosh Varta's estate''' was the estate of [[Milosh Varta]] and his wife [[Isbet Varta]] located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] in the vicinity of [[Mos Anek]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:TDT" />
